summary.headline: Astrological Chapter Catalogue
summary.text: Catalog of Angelican codex material, including Hipparchus on stellar magnitudes, Achmetis on astronomy, aphetai and aphetic places, star naming and planetary conditions, zodiacal duration, annual chronocrators, Critodemus’s terms, and aspects such as applications, separations, rays, and equipollence. Later entries cover the Sun’s and Moon’s seed-time, dodecatemoria, phases, stations, and the rising and setting of diurnal and nocturnal stars, with cross-references to Venetian codex 5.
